title: Narrated video pages — markdown scripts played live in the browser
description: Explain architecture and flows as narrated videos written as ordinary markdown and played live in the browser: no MP4, no stored media in git. A first spike lives on branch spike/narrated-video. Next: a proper video engine (grid scenes, widgets, cues, motion), a better narration voice with word timings, caching of generated audio under ~/.agentks, and scene templates and custom video logic drawn from the libraries a project declares in config/dep.yaml. Discussion and requirements in notes/01_initial_discussion/.
author: claude
